prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one transparent rear architecture layer, PH-30, for the Mass Effect Armax fighting-game project.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: our existing generated Port Hanshan interior prototype, not an exact canonical-location claim.
Primary request: keep only the interior structures behind the fighting plane. Maintain the same wide 16:9 full canvas, camera, lighting, scale and absolute placement as image 1. Preserve the ceiling, two storeys of window frames, catwalk and railings, diagonal concrete braces with their foot bases, central pier, wall panels, cyan wall lights and the two small orange side terminals. Keep every architectural feature at its original canvas position.
Remove the broad horizontal floor surface occupying approximately the bottom 27 percent of the source, beginning at the rear floor seam near y=690 on the 941-pixel-high reference. Replace the removed floor area with true alpha transparency. Preserve structural feet only to their existing wall/floor junction; do not extend walls, braces or terminals downward. Retain the existing transparent window openings and empty areas as genuine alpha. Do not fill them with a new exterior.
Output a single architecture layer: upper roughly 73 percent retains the source structures, lower floor strip is transparent. Do not crop, zoom, mirror, enlarge or recenter the remaining structure. No new floor, props, people, text, HUD, outline, checkerboard or opaque background. Keep original source framing; actual alpha transparency is required.
